title: You can shake; I need not move
odia:
ତୁ କେତେ ହଲଉଚୁ ହଲା...
ମୁଁ କିଛି ନହଲିଲେ ଗଲା...!!!
literal_meaning: Shake as much as you like; it is enough if I do not budge.
explanation: The speaker answers pressure with a challenge. Another person may keep trying to unsettle them, but the speaker claims control over their own response. The tone can convey resolve or stubbornness; its value depends on what they are refusing to yield about.
meaning_odia: ଅନ୍ୟେ ଯେତେ ଚାପ ଦେଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ନିଜ ସ୍ଥିରତା ରଖିବା।
usage_example: Friends tease someone to abandon a carefully considered decision; the reply insists that the teasing will not change it. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source introduces these lines as a response by someone determined. That introductory gloss is excluded from the headword. The digital ellipses and exclamation marks are retained, not claimed as ancient punctuation.

graphic.alt: A woman remains calm while two friends urge her to change a decision.
graphic.caption: Pressure need not decide the response.
